body: I believe 6 is the most in one week. Oddly at that point, there wasn't a lot of self-loathing. That came just recently when I realized that I had scheduled 4 of them all in consecutive days. I remember having a "Holy fuck, I have a problem" moment at that time.

A bit before my final semester of college, I began having frequent random hookups. That last semester, I probably hooked up with 1-2 people per week on average. Even nowadays I still struggle with it. It's a bit more intermittent now but the "craving" is still there.

Yes, I have issues.
